## Why

The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-000049-2b18, project ork, item S574:

say in the reviewer brief that a -run pattern anchored with $ is denied, and give the anchored form to use instead

Evidence: `-run TestRenderCLIViews$` was denied as "can't be checked before it runs", but the plain `-run TestRenderCLIViewsWritesFiles` was allowed.

Every read-only brief already carries one shared line that names the denied command forms (`deniedCommandForms`, `internal/engine/brief.go:129`, added under adj 519 `roles.read-only-allowlist-batch`). It is added to the Done-when checklist at `internal/engine/brief.go:353`. The line says nothing about `$` in a `go test -run` pattern, so a reviewer who anchors a pattern hits the denial and loses a round trip. The denial text is not ork's: `internal/agent/claude/pretool.go` has no such string, so it comes from the Claude Code harness. This slice adds one sentence to the shared line. It says an end anchor with `$` is denied and names the form to use instead.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-27: adj 623 (give -run NAME with the full test name, no anchor) and adj 624 (append the rule to deniedCommandForms, the adj 519 pattern).
